name: dhakafin
description: DhakaFin — Financial Intelligence, Accounting & Compliance SaaS platform for Bangladesh. Monorepo root.

scripts.dev: npm run tokens:build && npm run dev --workspace @dhakafin/web
scripts.build: npm run tokens:build && npm run build --workspace @dhakafin/web
scripts.verify: npm run tokens:validate && npm run tokens:build && npm run guard:tokens && npm run typecheck && npm run test:engine && npm run build && npm run guard:utilities && npm run guard:meta && npm run guard:links && npm run guard:estimate && npm run guard:pricing && npm run guard:fonts && npm run audit
scripts.test:engine: cd apps/web && node --experimental-strip-types --test lib/tools/engine.test.ts lib/cost-efficiency.test.ts lib/pricing.test.ts
